name: Date (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Date (Phoenix dactylifera) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 171726 (Dates, Deglet Noor) — full nutrient panel incl. individual sugars, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, fatty acids
USDA FoodData Central FDC 171707 (Dates, Medjool) — cultivar contrast for sugar profile
Moroccan date-syrup organic-acid & mineral study, J. Food Compos. Anal. doi:10.1016/j.jfca.2020.103576 (S0889157520302374)
Analysis of Sugars and Organic Acids of Date Palm 'Barhee' during fruit development (ResearchGate 260390876)
An Overview of Date Fruits as a Global Food Resource, PMC11011438 (moisture, macronutrient ranges)
provenance.curation_notes: Dates are a high-sugar, low-acid fruit: the dominant carbon/energy source is invert sugar — near-equal glucose (~19.9) and fructose (~19.6 g/100g) plus abundant sucrose (~23.8 g/100g in Deglet Noor; note Medjool is sucrose-free with glucose/fructose ~33/32 g/100g). Organic acids are minor and malic-dominant (acetic rises at the fully ripe tamr stage); total organic acids ~0.1-1 g/100g. Values are for ripe Deglet Noor (~20% water); Medjool differs mainly in the sugar split.
curation_added: malic acid (dominant organic acid, previously absent)
acetic acid, succinic acid, citric acid, oxalic acid (organic acids, previously absent)
individual sugars with real amounts (glucose 19.9, fructose 19.6, sucrose 23.8 g/100g)
L-phenylalanine, L-valine (amino acids missing from current record)
quantitative vitamin panel (B1/B2/B3/B5/B6/B9, C, E, K, choline, betaine)
quantitative mineral panel (K, P, Mg, Ca, Fe, Zn, Mn, Cu, Se)
water content, total protein, dietary fiber/pectin

curation_removed.name: Silicon

curation_removed.name: Genistein
curation_removed.reason: Isoflavone characteristic of legumes/soy; biologically implausible in date fruit; FooDB predicted-not-measured noise.

curation_removed.name: Isoflavones
curation_removed.reason: Legume/soy phytoestrogen class; implausible in dates; FooDB predicted noise.

curation_removed.name: (R)-Oxypeucedanin
curation_removed.reason: Furanocoumarin from Apiaceae (parsnip/celery); implausible in date fruit; FooDB predicted noise.

curation_removed.name: epsilon-Polylysine
curation_removed.reason: Bacterial (Streptomyces) fermentation biopolymer; not a native date compound; FooDB artifact.

curation_removed.name: (E)-2-Phenyl-2-butenal
curation_removed.reason: Trace flavour volatile aldehyde, not a growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: (±)-erythro-Isoleucine
curation_removed.reason: Predicted racemic/diastereomer artifact of isoleucine; duplicate of L-isoleucine.

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: Stereochemistry artifact; the biological amino acid in date protein is L-serine (added).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
